title: A Second-Order Asymptotic Expansion for Nonlinear Filtering in the Lorenz--63 System
summary: A challenge in nonlinear filtering is to incorporate nonlinear effects into approximations of the conditional mean while retaining a finite-dimensional recursive algorithm. We derive a second-order asymptotic expansion of the filtering mean with respect to the system-noise intensity. We apply this expansion to the Lorenz--63 model, a prototypical three-dimensional chaotic dynamical system. The first-order approximation is computed using a Kalman--Bucy filter for the system linearized around the deterministic reference trajectory.
